contentHtml:
Hyderabad: Gland Pharma Limited has appointed Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) of its wholly owned subsidiary, Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd., Singapore, effective November 9, 2026.

According to the company's regulatory filing, Xiao Le will focus on identifying investment opportunities and strengthening Gland Pharma's mergers and acquisitions (M&A) capabilities across the United States, China, Singapore and other international markets.

In his new role, Xiao Le will report to the CEO of Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd.

Xiao Le Brings Over 15 Years of Healthcare Investment Experience

Xiao Le brings more than 15 years of experience in investment and asset management across medical devices, biopharmaceuticals, diagnostics and tools, and healthcare services.

His professional experience includes serving as Chief Financial Officer of MegaRobo Technologies in Singapore and as a Director on the Board of CANbridge Pharmaceuticals in the United States, representing WuXi.

He has also held the position of Senior Director of M&A and Strategic Investments at WuXi AppTec and served as a Director at Dimensions Capital. His earlier professional experience includes various roles at Middleton Gardiner Group, LLC, the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Bank of America Merrill Lynch.

His international experience spans Singapore, China and the United States, giving him exposure to multiple healthcare and investment markets.

Xiao Le holds a Bachelor's degree in Bioengineering from Johns Hopkins University and a Master's degree in Finance from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).

His academic background, combined with extensive experience in healthcare investments and strategic transactions, is expected to support his responsibilities in evaluating investment opportunities and strengthening Gland Pharma's global M&A capabilities.

The appointment comes as Gland Pharma seeks to strengthen its investment and strategic acquisition capabilities across key international markets.

By bringing an experienced investment professional into a leadership role at its Singapore subsidiary, the company aims to enhance its ability to explore opportunities across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical technology and broader healthcare sectors.

The company's regulatory disclosure does not specify any particular acquisition, investment target or transaction timeline. However, Xiao Le's mandate covers investment opportunities and M&A development across the US, China, Singapore and other countries.

Gland Pharma Limited is a Hyderabad-headquartered pharmaceutical company. The company has its registered office in Dundigal, Telangana.
